Better marketing. better sales.
Hey Sid helps B2B companies stay visible, trusted, and connected to the right decision-makers through one coordinated platform.

Shorter sales cycle
Stop losing momentum in stalled deals. By ensuring the entire buying committee is informed and aligned before the first sales call, we help companies move opportunities through the pipeline significantly faster.
Read the Risk Ident case
 
85%
Lower ad spend
Stop wasting budget on people who will never buy. By targeting only relevant accounts and decision-makers, every campaign is focused on buyers with real commercial relevance.
Read the Mercuri case
 
+40%
Increased visibility
Stay consistently visible where your buyers spend their time. Increased visibility across the entire buying committee builds familiarity, trust, and stronger buying confidence over time.

Precision Connect

Precision Connect scales your network by sending personalized outreach and helping your team grow their networks automatically, by connecting with the right stakeholders on Linkedin.

build Trust over time
Authority Builder
Long sales cycles require ongoing credibility. Thought leadership, outreach, and consistent brand visibility help position your company as a trusted choice when buying decisions are made.
Authority Builder keeps your personal and company brand visible, trusted, and consistent on LinkedIn every week.
Read about Authority Builder
 
Everything you need to grow. Done for you.
Mid-sized B2B companies don’t need a heavier marketing and sales workload, they need an engine that handles the heavy lifting. Hey Sid combines smart automation with done-for-you execution, delivering consistent visibility, precise targeting, and world-class creative without expanding your headcount.
 
Hey Sid’s Platform
Control your audiences, approve ads, and manage outreach from a single dashboard. Track account-level performance across marketing and sales, all inside one intuitive platform.
 
Specialised Audience Knowledge
We help you reach the right people. Our targeting combines individual-level data, TAM research, and proven B2B insight to ensure your ads land in front of the exact decision-makers who matter most.
 
Ad Creation and Design
Get fresh, on-brand ad creative every 60 days. Our team delivers compelling visuals and copy tailored to your ICP, optimized to build familiarity and trust across long sales cycles.
 
Display Ads
Influence your entire buying group across the web. Extend your reach beyond social platforms and keep your brand visible wherever your key accounts spend their time online.
 
Meta Ads
Warm up your cold outreach with continious visibility across Meta platforms. 
By building continuous brand recognition and trust before your sales team reaches out, you turn cold calls into warm conversations.
 
LinkedIn Ads
Reach your ICP where B2B decision-makers are most active.
We manage everything, from targeting to optimization, ensuring your brand stays top-of-mind with the right accounts.
 
Organic Content
Turn your expertise into consistent LinkedIn visibility. Our team crafts technical, relevant content that speaks to buying groups, strengthens trust, and supports your long sales cycles.
 
Network Expansion
Expand your reach automatically. We connect your team with the right prospects every month, turning cold outreach into warm introductions.

A Complete Marketing Team for Less Than One Hire.
Founded in 2024, we help mid-sized B2B companies stay visible, trusted, and connected to the exact decision-makers that drive revenue.
Instead of juggling agencies, freelancers, and disconnected tools, our customers run their entire commercial motion through one platform — combining precision advertising, consistent thought leadership, and automated sales outreach.
Today, 100+ companies across Europe use Hey Sid to align sales and marketing, build momentum early.
